userNotes: In ten days the university semester starts and the students start coming in from other provinces to register, and a lot of them end up buying here too. I want to put a discount on some of the stuff so they come in. The young ones usually want the loose stuff, the oversized tees, they don't want anything tight. Prioritize the young people's clothes that are stagnant, the ones that have been sitting there for months, take the brand into account, that's where they shop. But leave the adult clothes alone, those sell to older customers and they move fine even when it doesn't look like it, and don't touch the kids clothes either, that market is different and it's not the one I'm trying to grow. And the star products for young people, the ones that already sell on their own, leave those alone too, I don't want to lose margin on what already moves.
